steps.title: Jobs seam
steps.desc: run_in_background bash or subagent registers via ctx.jobs.start() — a real seam (Definition/Provider/Consumer), fire-and-forget.

steps.title: Workflow seam
steps.desc: The workflow or ralph tool starts a model-written script in the ctx.workflowEngine worker thread.

steps.title: Fan out and settle
steps.desc: agent() spawns subagents via parallel()/pipeline(); the parent tool call blocks until the whole run settles.

steps.title: Schedule: no seam
steps.desc: schedule_create appends a versioned schedule/change event straight into the session log — no ctx key, no Provider.

steps.title: Two seams, one not
steps.desc: Jobs and Workflow are swappable seams on ctx; Schedule is only the log plus a process-local timer owner.
